description: Implementation of the Shutdown task class for the Rialto media server, responsible for stopping the worker thread of the associated media player.

classes.name: Shutdown
classes.description: A class representing a shutdown task that stops the worker thread of the media player.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Shutdown task with a reference to the media player.

methods.name: ~Shutdown
methods.description: Destructor that logs the shutdown completion.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the shutdown task by stopping the worker thread of the media player.
